label: Covering every vertex
subgoals: Identify every vertex that must be covered.
Choose edges that touch all vertices.
Minimize the number of chosen edges.

label: Testing a proposed cover
subgoals: Mark the endpoints of every proposed edge.
Count the vertices that remain unmarked.
Decide whether the proposed set is an edge cover.

label: Edge covers and matchings
subgoals: Subtract its size from the number of vertices.
Check that no vertex is isolated.
